issue.title: gui: a sign-in's risk step squeezes its warning to nothing at narrow widths, and German "Trotzdem anmelden" runs past the edge at 420
issue.body:
I found this while checking the GUI tests for #2043. It's a separate bug, so it isn't fixed there.

**Where it happens.** `renderSigning` in `internal/gui/assets/app.js`, the `signing.state === "risk"` branch, shown for subscriptions with a ban risk (Antigravity's suspension notice, and the like). It puts these on one flex row (`.signing`, app.css ~2509):
- the "!" mark;
- the warning text (`.tt`, `flex: 1; min-width: 0`);
- two or three buttons: Cancel, Import instead…, and Sign in anyway.

**What goes wrong.** The buttons don't shrink, so at narrow widths:
- The warning column, which is the thing the user has to read before signing in, gets squeezed to (nearly) zero width. Its text breaks into a column of single characters, or collapses.
- In German at 420px, "Trotzdem anmelden" runs past the card's right edge.

**What a fix should do:** put the buttons on their own row under the text when they don't fit (wrap `.signing`, or move the buttons into a `.acts` row as the other states do), so the warning always keeps a readable width.

**How to check it:** add a GUI test in Chromium and WebKit, at 360/420/1100, in every language. It should assert that the warning's width is at least a sensible minimum and that no button extends past the card.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/2099-risk-wrap` (head `68bbfcf5`, on upstream `6eb510f7`) — the sign-in risk step keeps its warning readable and its buttons inside the card.

**Root cause.** `internal/gui/assets/app.js`'s `renderSigning` put the "!" mark, the warning text (`.tt`, `flex:1; min-width:0`) and two or three buttons on one flex row (`.signing`, app.css), so at 420px the warning column collapsed to a few characters and German "Trotzdem anmelden" ran past the card's edge.

**Change.** the risk branch's buttons move into their own `.risk-acts` row the way the other signing states already do, and `.signing.risk` wraps (`flex-wrap: wrap`, `row-gap: 8px`) with the text given a basis (`flex: 1 1 320px`). The shared `.signing` rule is untouched (the reporter's first attempt broke `signin-closes-sheet.test.cjs`); no new strings, so nothing to translate.

**Verified.** Red: `the new `risk-wrap.test.cjs` (playwright in a container) against base assets` → `warning is wide enough (141.9px)` — 45px in German at 360
Green: `same command → 18/18 (chromium + webkit × en/zh/de × 360/420/1100); `signin-closes-sheet`, `claude-risk`, `commandcode-risk` still pass; `TestCoreScriptBudget` unchanged` → `ℹ pass 18, fail 0`

This is the same defect #2824 (oxsean) measured and sketched a fix for on a fork — the wrap and the `.risk-acts` row follow that shape, credited to oxsean's measuring; the two issues can close together.

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 27's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6eb510f7` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/2099-risk-wrap — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
